config_fields.name: domain
config_fields.help: Country gateway of the seller's shop: sg, com.my, co.th, co.id, com.ph or vn → https://api.lazada.{domain}/rest (Service Endpoints on every API page).

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: App Key of your Lazada Open Platform app (App Console).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: App Secret of the same app; signs every call: uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API name (e.g. /order/get) + the parameters sorted by name as name+value. Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Seller access_token from the seller-authorisation code exchange (/auth/token/create). It expires (see expires_in); renew it with the signed system API /auth/token/refresh and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

me.note: GetSeller: the authorised seller (seller_id, name, short_code, status).

list_products.note: GetProducts: the AUTHORISED SELLER's own products (Lazada's open platform is seller-side), all statuses, 50 per page at most (offset up to 10,000). Price/SKU/stock are the FIRST SKU's, in the shop's local currency; `id` is the item_id for get_product. No keyword search (sku_seller_list matches whole Seller SKUs only).

get_product.note: GetProductItem: one product of the authorised seller by item_id; every SKU is in raw.skus.

get_order.note: GetOrder: an order RECEIVED by the authorised seller. `status` is the first of statuses[] (pending, ready_to_ship, shipped, delivered, canceled, …); `total` is the order price in local currency; `created_at` is '2014-10-15 18:36:05 +0800' style. Line items: /order/items/get (not mapped).

track.note: GetOrderTrace: one row per package with its tracking number and logistic_detail_info_list[{title, description, status_code, event_time (ms)}].

not_offered.quote_shipping: The Lazada Open Platform APIs (https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/api) are seller-side (Seller, Product, Order, Logistics …); there is no buyer-side freight quote for sourcing.
not_offered.create_order: Orders are placed by shoppers; the Order API group (GetOrder, GetOrders, GetOrderItems, SetInvoiceNumber …, https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/api?path=%2Forder%2Fget) has no order creation.

adapter.terms: Lazada Open Platform: GET/POST https://api.lazada.{domain}/rest{api_name} with app_key, timestamp (ms, within 7200 s), sign_method=sha256, access_token and sign = uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256(app_secret, api_name + sorted name+value) where api_name excludes the /rest gateway prefix ('Signature algorithm', https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068).

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, access_token, domain; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
